subject: Dogs for Days Special Permit Denial
overview: The council held a major public hearing on a controversial dog kennel permit and approved several infrastructure and municipal finance measures, including MWRA loans and solar energy contracts.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses
items.summary: Approved a license for Semolina but tabled a petition for City Bazaar because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: MBTA Cellular Towers Resolution
items.summary: Discussed and placed on file a resolution regarding proposed 73-foot MBTA cell towers in residential neighborhoods following opposition from residents and the City Solicitor.

items.title: Law Department Claim Settlement
items.summary: Approved a $7,500 settlement for a property damage claim resulting from a city water line blockage on Sylvia Road.

items.title: Community Preservation Fund Budget
items.summary: Approved the fiscal year 2018 Community Preservation Fund revenue and expenditure recommendations totaling $1,428,649.

items.title: Meadow Glen Mall Signage
items.summary: Approved 15 signs for the mall redevelopment but referred a sign advertising alcohol to the Business and Economic Development Subcommittee.

items.title: Global Healthcare Services Signage
items.summary: Referred a sign denial reversal petition back to subcommittee with a request for the landlord to attend the next discussion.

items.title: DPW Solar Power Purchase Agreement
items.summary: Authorized a 20-year agreement with Select Energy Development LLC for solar panels on the DPW building, estimated to save the city $455,000 over the contract life.

items.title: Chevalier Theater Licensing and Management
items.summary: Approved a Home Rule Petition for unified liquor and victualler licensing at the theater and authorized a five-year management contract term.

items.title: Food Truck Event Licensing
items.summary: Approved licensing for food trucks at various city events scheduled for August through October 2017.

items.title: Public Hearing: Dogs for Days Special Permit
items.summary: The motion to approve a special permit for a dog kennel at 29 Linden Street failed following extensive debate over noise mitigation, waste management, and the impact on abutting residential units.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Adopted resolutions of condolence for the families of Judge Lee Johnson and Rosemary Alfie.

items.title: Water Infrastructure Loans and Transfers
items.summary: Passed a first reading for a $2,075,000 zero-interest MWRA loan and approved a $1.5 million transfer from water and sewer retained earnings for infrastructure and lead service replacements.

items.title: Subcommittee Report: Ultimate Tango Signage
items.summary: Approved the subcommittee report and the corresponding sign reversal petition for Ultimate Tango.

items.title: Petitions from Andrew Castagnetti and Robert Penta
items.summary: Placed a petition regarding tobacco regulations on file and tabled Robert Penta's petition regarding the Community Preservation Act to the August meeting.

items.title: Routine Resolutions and Minutes
items.summary: Approved resolutions regarding a birth announcement and park paving, and approved the meeting minutes as amended.
